purpose: Test the coordinate-aligned condition of the checkpoint-auditability theory while reducing compute and avoiding another poison-parameter search.

source_clean_checkpoints.selection: the archived clean checkpoints from the frozen PathMNIST V2 development run
source_clean_checkpoints.status: previously observed development checkpoints; this pilot is not confirmation

unchanged_data_attack_and_detector.attack: V2 BadNets all-to-one: 810 overwritten rows (3%), target class 8, 5x5 white bottom-right patch
unchanged_data_attack_and_detector.test: full official external-center PathMNIST test split
unchanged_data_attack_and_detector.victim_gates: external-center balanced CA at least 0.75 and test ASR at least 0.80

warmstart_finetuning.initialization: bit-identical archived clean checkpoint for the same seed
warmstart_finetuning.coordinate_alignment_check: the fine-tuning initial state SHA-256 must equal the source clean state SHA-256
warmstart_finetuning.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch 3; no early stopping or outcome-based epoch selection
warmstart_finetuning.augmentation: independent horizontal and vertical flips with probability 0.5

requirements: both archived source clean models meet the 0.75 external-center CA gate
both warm-start suspect victims meet CA and ASR gates
initial suspect state exactly matches the source clean state
all defined detector scores are finite
gate.pass_action: authorize writing, but not running, a separate fresh-seed confirmation protocol
gate.fail_action: stop PathMNIST lightweight-victim expansion; do not tune epochs, learning rate, poison fraction or patch size on these seeds

interpretation.theory_link: Unlike independently trained clean/suspect pairs, this warm-start construction preserves a shared parameter coordinate system and directly exercises the stated conditional drift proposition.
forbidden_claims: deployable clean checkpoints are always available
paired drift superiority without a passed comparison gate
